title.en: SiliconFlow Free Models 2026: Current List, Limits and API Example
title.zh: SiliconFlow 免费模型 2026：当前清单、限额与 API 示例

excerpt.en: A verified snapshot of SiliconFlow models currently marked free on the official pricing page, plus identity verification, fixed rate limits, Pro model naming, and a first API call.
excerpt.zh: 依据硅基流动官方价格页整理当前标记为免费的模型，并说明实名认证、固定限额、Pro 命名规则与首次 API 调用。

heading.zh: 2026 年 8 月 10 日核验的免费模型

en: SiliconFlow's official pricing page currently marks the following text models as free for both input and output. The catalog changes, so treat this as a dated snapshot and confirm the live price before production use.

The same official page also lists free embedding, reranking, image, and speech models. This guide separates those modalities so a free text model is not confused with a free embedding or media endpoint.
zh: 硅基流动官方价格页当前将下列文本模型的输入和输出均标记为“免费”。模型目录会变化，因此这是一份带核验日期的快照；投入生产前仍应检查实时价格。
官方页面还列出了免费的 Embedding、Rerank、图像和语音模型。本文按模态拆分，避免把免费文本模型与免费向量或媒体接口混为一谈。

en: The current pricing page also marks BAAI/bge-m3, BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3, BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5 and BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 as free. Kolors is listed as a free image model, while TeleAI/TeleSpeechASR and FunAudioLLM/SenseVoiceSmall are listed as free speech models.
zh: 当前价格页还将 BAAI/bge-m3、BAAI/bge-reranker-v2-m3、BAAI/bge-large-zh-v1.5 和 BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 标记为免费；Kolors 被列为免费生图模型，TeleAI/TeleSpeechASR 与 FunAudioLLM/SenseVoiceSmall 被列为免费语音模型。

en: SiliconFlow's official rate-limit documentation says identity verification is required to use all free models. Calls to free models are billed at zero, but their rate limits are fixed and cannot be increased by moving up a paid usage tier.

Some models have both a free and paid service. The free model uses the ordinary vendor/model ID; the paid version adds the Pro/ prefix. Paid models use account-level rate limits based on usage. Check the console for the exact live limit of a model instead of relying on a static RPM copied into an article.
zh: 硅基流动官方限流文档说明，完成实名认证后才能使用全部免费模型。免费模型调用费用为 0，但其 Rate Limits 是固定值，不能通过提升付费用量等级来提高。
部分模型同时提供免费版与收费版：免费版使用普通的“厂商/模型”ID，收费版在前面增加 Pro/。收费模型的限额随账户用量等级变化。具体模型的实时限额应在控制台查看，不应依赖文章里写死的 RPM。

heading.en: New-user credit: ¥16 in China or $1 globally
heading.zh: 新用户赠金：中国站 ¥16，国际站 $1

en: SiliconFlow's official June 2026 product announcement states that new users can receive ¥16 on the China site or $1 on the global site to try platform models. This promotional credit is separate from zero-priced models and can be used to test paid models under the applicable campaign rules.
zh: 硅基流动 2026 年 6 月官方产品公告说明，新用户可获得中国站 ¥16 或国际站 $1 赠金，用于体验平台模型。赠金与价格为 0 的免费模型是两套概念，可按活动规则测试付费模型。

heading.zh: 第一次免费 API 调用

en: Create a key at https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/me/account/ak, complete identity verification, and select a model still marked free on the live pricing page. SiliconFlow accepts the OpenAI SDK at the China endpoint shown below.
zh: 在 https://cloud.siliconflow.cn/me/account/ak 创建 Key，完成实名认证，并选择实时价格页仍标记为免费的模型。硅基流动可通过 OpenAI SDK 调用，下面使用中国站端点。

codeBlocks.code:
from openai import OpenAI
import os

client = OpenAI(
    api_key=os.environ["SILICONFLOW_API_KEY"],
    base_url="https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1",
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Reply with: KEY_WORKS"}],
)
print(response.choices[0].message.content)

caption.zh: OpenAI 兼容 Python 请求

en: Confirm the model still appears as free, verify its current rate limit in the console, use the full namespaced model ID, and keep a paid fallback if a fixed free-model limit cannot meet production traffic. For account setup, see [[guide:how-to-get-silicon-flow-api-key|the SiliconFlow API key tutorial]].
zh: 确认模型仍显示免费、在控制台核对实时限额、使用完整命名空间模型 ID，并在免费模型固定限额无法支撑生产流量时准备付费回退方案。账户开通步骤请参阅[[guide:how-to-get-silicon-flow-api-key|硅基流动 API Key 教程]]。

question.en: Is the SiliconFlow API completely free?

answer.en: No. SiliconFlow has both free and paid models. Models marked free are billed at zero within fixed rate limits; paid models are charged according to the live pricing page.
answer.zh: 不是。硅基流动同时有免费与付费模型。标记为免费的模型在固定限额内费用为 0；付费模型按实时价格页计费。

question.en: Is identity verification required for free models?
question.zh: 免费模型需要实名认证吗？

answer.en: SiliconFlow's official rate-limit documentation says identity verification is required to use all free models.
answer.zh: 硅基流动官方限流文档说明，使用全部免费模型需要完成实名认证。

question.en: Can I raise a free model's rate limit?
question.zh: 免费模型的限额可以提升吗？

answer.en: The official documentation says free-model rate limits are fixed. Where available, a Pro/ version is paid and follows paid-model limits.
answer.zh: 官方文档说明免费模型限额固定。若平台提供对应 Pro/ 版本，它属于收费模型并采用收费模型限额。

question.en: How much credit do new SiliconFlow users get?
question.zh: SiliconFlow 新用户有多少赠金？

answer.en: The current official announcement states ¥16 for China-site users or $1 for global-site users. Campaign availability should be confirmed when registering.
answer.zh: 当前官方公告写明中国站新用户 ¥16、国际站新用户 $1；注册时仍应确认活动是否继续有效。
